name: Rigathi Gachagua
position: Former Deputy President of Kenya (Impeached Oct 2024)

promises.promise: Guaranteed minimum returns and cartel eradication for coffee, tea & dairy farmers
promises.evidence: Spearheaded coffee reforms taskforce and Coffee Act amendments with ongoing legislative review.

promises.promise: Clear all verified national and county pending bills within 90 days of taking office
promises.evidence: National Treasury documented that verified pending bills exceeded Ksh 500 Billion as of late 2024.

scandals.name: Parliamentary & Senate Impeachment on Unexplained Wealth
scandals.status: Impeached by National Assembly and Senate
scandals.summary: National Assembly and Senate sustained impeachment articles citing unexplained asset accumulation, conflict of interest, and constitutional violations; contested in High Court.

scandals.name: Nyeri County Government Tender Recovery Case
scandals.entity: Nyeri County Government / Assets Recovery Agency (ARA)
scandals.status: Withdrawn by ODPP / ARA in late 2022
scandals.summary: Asset Recovery Agency (ARA) frozen bank accounts case dropped by prosecutors citing insufficient corroborating forensic evidence.
